coverage.title: Alien: Covenant V012 missing coverage audit

scope.reasonAnimationTotalNotGiven: The source inventory specifies no finite frame budget for every run, crawl, action, direction or creature movement state. Missing cycles/states are listed without inventing a total number of PNGs.
scope.runtimeMeaning: Source admission and renderer eligibility only, assuming decoded PNGs and visibility. This is not a new browser-render or playthrough certification.
scope.oneToOneMeaning: Availability, pose coverage and runtime admission do not establish pixel-identical film fidelity.

humanCoverage.sourceDirections: Generated originals face right; ordinary left-facing rendering may mirror. Walter-injured left-facing deliberately remains procedural.

profiles.directionRestriction: left-facing keeps procedural to preserve anatomical left-hand injury

items.blocker: No specific bedding in David's quarters identified visually; expedition bedrolls are a different item.
Official art-book spread shows the cabin set and a tiny log-cabin model; no sufficiently resolved cabin plan/model image.
David's cloak is documented; a cloak stand is not. Do not invent a support.
Worn expedition harnesses are documented; a matching rack is not. No weapon-containing rack may be substituted.
The nail pendant is identified, but no accessible inspected close view resolves its shape, cord and attachment.
David workroom frames are available, but no individual notebook cover/binding and full silhouette have been identified.
The documented three-cylinder Lander tank rack is a different assembly from this portable-case adaptation.
Walter's embryo-disposal scene is identified; the exact empty waste vessel has not been isolated visually.
No complete personal tether assembly matched to evaprep/sailaccess is verified. The exterior sail winch is a different machine.

excludedFromNewGenerationByTask: previously refused subjects and their variants
notes: A profile is a costume/appearance key, not a unique actor identity. The 23 inventory profiles plus Oram-field and Karine-medical make 25 static human PNGs, not 25 distinct people.
Eight walk frames form one state binding and one cycle; they do not add eight profiles or eight distinct movement types.

All 126 prop families and 630 instances are enumerated. The count without a PNG includes preserved mechanisms, environments, generic assets and gameplay adaptations; it is not a claim that every one requires a new film-exact PNG.
Related drawings and heavy EVA/closed-pod variants are catalogued separately from a proven match to a particular scene instance.
Catalogue table E1027 and Bugatti throne cannot be counted as generic DLC chair/table coverage. Biological embryo art is not automatically a specimen or embryo-tray replacement.
No new sprite generation, branch movement, central manifest write or integration-code change was performed by this audit.

contracts.scope: Registry, renderer, exact source metadata, original source conservation and standalone distribution; Image/Canvas doubles explicitly declared in unit tests.

localBrowser.reason: No runnable Chromium binary. Supported Playwright installation returned HTTP403 before download; no alternate download route attempted.

githubActions.scope: Run results on the exact new commit are separate from this pre-CI local record. The workflow checks full host source/build/dist, original pilots, game controls and offline catalogue.

priorEvidence.appliesTo: V011 only; not counted as V012 execution

limits: The complete requested asset and animation coverage has not been reached.
A generated pose is not a pixel-identical film frame.
The source inventory does not define a finite total of frames across all directions and action states; no invented complete-PNG count is reported.
Runtime admission is scoped to declared states, rooms and exact prop instances.
